basics.name: Abby Ortego
basics.summary: My research interest is in Human AI Interaction. I explore the unique challenges that arise when a solution to a problem cannot be fully automated and a user is required to collaborate with some form of automation to achieve a common goal. I aim to build more effective autonomous assistants that focus on enhancing user understanding, reducing cognitive load, and promoting more rational decision-making processes.
